<!--
Purpose: adjust the predicted AC counts so they do not exceed the number of
housing units reported by the Census, at the tract, county, block group and
ZIP code (ZCTA) levels (proportional scaling, see Data/readme.md).

Working directory: an .Rmd file uses the folder it lives in as the working
directory, so all files below are relative to this file's folder.

Inputs:
  nhgis_tr2020_tr2010.csv             - NHGIS 2020 -> 2010 tract crosswalk (https://www.nhgis.org/geographic-crosswalks)
  results/FINALdata/summary_*_{year}.csv - AC summaries written by ACprob_to_county_zip.py
  Totalhousing_{year}_zcta.csv        - ZCTA-level total housing units downloaded from the Census Bureau
  Housing-unit totals for tracts, counties and block groups are downloaded with tidycensus
  (requires a Census API key: https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html, then tidycensus::census_api_key()).
Outputs:
  results/FINALdata/summary_{tract,county,grp}_adjusted_{year}.csv and summary_zcta_adjusted_{year}.csv
-->

```{r}
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)  # dplyr, readr, tidyr, stringr
```

# census tract level
```{r}
# Download total population by county for 2020 ACS 5-year

# Get vector of all state abbreviations (or use fips_codes if you want state codes)
state_list <- unique(fips_codes$state)[1:51]  # Exclude PR if needed

# Initialize empty list to store each state's data
acs_list <- list()

# Loop through each state and fetch ACS data
for (state_abbr in state_list) {
  message("Getting data for state: ", state_abbr)
  try({
    acs_data <- get_acs(
      geography = "tract",
      variables = c(totalhouse = "B07013_001E"),
      year = 2010,
      survey = "acs5",
      state = state_abbr,
      geometry = FALSE,
      cache_table = TRUE
    )
    acs_list[[state_abbr]] <- acs_data
  }, silent = TRUE)  # If a state fails, skip it
}

# Combine all into one dataframe
acs_2010_all <- bind_rows(acs_list)

# Check result
glimpse(acs_2010_all)
```

#adjusting for min_max match with decinial 
```{r}

# Define file paths
prediction_files <- list(
  "2010" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_tract_2010.csv",
  "2015" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_tract_2015.csv",
  "2020" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_tract_2020.csv"
)

# Output file names
output_files <- list(
  "2010" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_tract_adjusted_2010.csv",
  "2015" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_tract_adjusted_2015.csv",
  "2020" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_tract_adjusted_2020.csv"
)

# Load and prepare housing units data (10-digit non-padded IDs, no sprintf needed)
housing_units <- read_csv("./Totalhousing_2020.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    GEOID = as.character(GEOID),
    tr2010ge = as.character(tr2010ge)
  ) %>%
  distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Function to adjust counts and save
adjust_counts <- function(year, prediction_file, housing_data, output_file) {
  df <- read_csv(prediction_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if ("GEOID10" %in% names(df)) df <- rename(df, GEOID = GEOID10)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID)) %>%
    distinct()

  # Join on appropriate key
  if (year %in% c("2010", "2015")) {
    adjusted <- df %>%
      left_join(housing_data %>% select(tr2010ge, total_units),
                by = c("GEOID" = "tr2010ge"))
  } else {
    adjusted <- df %>%
      left_join(housing_data %>% select(GEOID, total_units), by = "GEOID")
  }

  # Derive GEOIDCN (remove last 6 tract digits) and do adjustment
  adjusted <- adjusted %>%
    mutate(GEOIDCN = str_sub(GEOID, 1, -7)) %>%
    group_by(GEOID) %>%
    mutate(
      total_predicted = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
      scaling_factor = if_else(total_predicted > total_units, total_units / total_predicted, 1),
      Adjusted_Count = round(Count * scaling_factor),
      Adjusted_Percentage = round(100 * Adjusted_Count / sum(Adjusted_Count), 2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Final select of columns
  adjusted <- adjusted %>%
    select(GEOIDCN, GEOID, ACtype, Adjusted_Count, Adjusted_Percentage) %>%
    drop_na(GEOID)

  # Save to file
  write_csv(adjusted, output_file)
  return(adjusted)
}

# Apply to each file
adjusted_data <- mapply(
  adjust_counts,
  year = names(prediction_files),
  prediction_file = prediction_files,
  output_file = output_files,
  MoreArgs = list(housing_data = housing_units),
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE
)

```

# county level adjustment
```{r}

# Download county-level total housing units from Census for a given year
get_county_housing <- function(year) {
  state_list <- unique(fips_codes$state)[1:51]
  result_list <- list()
  for (state_abbr in state_list) {
    message("Getting county housing for state: ", state_abbr, " (", year, ")")
    try({
      if (year == 2020) {
        dat <- get_decennial(
          geography = "county",
          variables = "H1_001N",
          year = 2020,
          state = state_abbr,
          geometry = FALSE,
          cache_table = TRUE
        ) %>%
          select(GEOID, total_units = value)
      } else {
        dat <- get_acs(
          geography = "county",
          variables = "B25001_001",
          year = year,
          survey = "acs5",
          state = state_abbr,
          geometry = FALSE,
          cache_table = TRUE
        ) %>%
          select(GEOID, total_units = estimate)
      }
      result_list[[state_abbr]] <- dat
    }, silent = TRUE)
  }
  bind_rows(result_list) %>%
    mutate(GEOID = sprintf("%05d", as.integer(GEOID))) %>%
    distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Download housing data for each year
housing_county_2010 <- get_county_housing(2010)
housing_county_2015 <- get_county_housing(2015)
housing_county_2020 <- get_county_housing(2020)

# Input prediction files (output from ACprob_to_county_zip.py)
county_prediction_files <- list(
  "2010" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_county_2010.csv",
  "2015" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_county_2015.csv",
  "2020" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_county_2020.csv"
)

# Output files
county_output_files <- list(
  "2010" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_county_adjusted_2010.csv",
  "2015" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_county_adjusted_2015.csv",
  "2020" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_county_adjusted_2020.csv"
)

# Housing data list keyed by year
county_housing_list <- list(
  "2010" = housing_county_2010,
  "2015" = housing_county_2015,
  "2020" = housing_county_2020
)

# Adjust county-level AC counts using housing units as a cap
adjust_county_counts <- function(year, prediction_file, housing_data, output_file) {
  df <- read_csv(prediction_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(GEOID = sprintf("%05d", as.integer(GEOID))) %>%
    distinct()

  adjusted <- df %>%
    left_join(housing_data %>% select(GEOID, total_units), by = "GEOID") %>%
    group_by(GEOID) %>%
    mutate(
      total_predicted     = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
      scaling_factor      = if_else(total_predicted > total_units, total_units / total_predicted, 1),
      Adjusted_Count      = round(Count * scaling_factor),
      Adjusted_Percentage = round(100 * Adjusted_Count / sum(Adjusted_Count), 2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(GEOID, ACtype, Adjusted_Count, Adjusted_Percentage) %>%
    drop_na(GEOID)

  write_csv(adjusted, output_file)
  message("Saved: ", output_file)
  return(adjusted)
}

# Apply across all years
county_adjusted_data <- Map(
  adjust_county_counts,
  year            = names(county_prediction_files),
  prediction_file = county_prediction_files,
  housing_data    = county_housing_list,
  output_file     = county_output_files
)
```

# block group level adjustment
```{r}

# Download block-group-level total housing units for a given year
get_blkgrp_housing <- function(year) {
  state_list <- unique(fips_codes$state)[1:51]
  result_list <- list()
  for (state_abbr in state_list) {
    message("Getting block group housing for state: ", state_abbr, " (", year, ")")
    try({
      if (year == 2000) {
        dat <- get_decennial(
          geography = "block group",
          variables = "H001001",
          year = 2000,
          state = state_abbr,
          sumfile = "sf1",
          geometry = FALSE,
          cache_table = TRUE
        ) %>%
          select(GEOID, total_units = value)
      } else {
        dat <- get_acs(
          geography = "block group",
          variables = "B25001_001",
          year = year,
          survey = "acs5",
          state = state_abbr,
          geometry = FALSE,
          cache_table = TRUE
        ) %>%
          select(GEOID, total_units = estimate)
      }
      result_list[[state_abbr]] <- dat
    }, silent = TRUE)
  }
  bind_rows(result_list) %>%
    mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID)) %>%
    distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Download housing data for each year
housing_blkgrp_2000 <- get_blkgrp_housing(2000)
housing_blkgrp_2010 <- get_blkgrp_housing(2010)
housing_blkgrp_2015 <- get_blkgrp_housing(2015)
housing_blkgrp_2020 <- get_blkgrp_housing(2020)

# Input prediction files
blkgrp_prediction_files <- list(
  "2000" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_grp_2000.csv",
  "2010" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_grp_2010.csv",
  "2015" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_grp_2015.csv",
  "2020" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_grp_2020.csv"
)

# Output files
blkgrp_output_files <- list(
  "2000" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_grp_adjusted_2000.csv",
  "2010" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_grp_adjusted_2010.csv",
  "2015" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_grp_adjusted_2015.csv",
  "2020" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_grp_adjusted_2020.csv"
)

# Housing data list keyed by year
blkgrp_housing_list <- list(
  "2000" = housing_blkgrp_2000,
  "2010" = housing_blkgrp_2010,
  "2015" = housing_blkgrp_2015,
  "2020" = housing_blkgrp_2020
)

# Adjust block-group-level AC counts using housing units as a cap
adjust_blkgrp_counts <- function(year, prediction_file, housing_data, output_file) {
  df <- read_csv(prediction_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  # Standardize GEOID column name (2000 uses STFID, 2010+ uses GEOID10)
  if ("STFID"   %in% names(df)) df <- rename(df, GEOID = STFID)
  if ("GEOID10" %in% names(df)) df <- rename(df, GEOID = GEOID10)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID)) %>%
    distinct()

  adjusted <- df %>%
    left_join(housing_data %>% select(GEOID, total_units), by = "GEOID") %>%
    group_by(GEOID) %>%
    mutate(
      total_predicted     = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
      scaling_factor      = if_else(total_predicted > total_units, total_units / total_predicted, 1),
      Adjusted_Count      = round(Count * scaling_factor),
      Adjusted_Percentage = round(100 * Adjusted_Count / sum(Adjusted_Count), 2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(GEOID, ACtype, Adjusted_Count, Adjusted_Percentage) %>%
    drop_na(GEOID)

  write_csv(adjusted, output_file)
  message("Saved: ", output_file)
  return(adjusted)
}

# Apply across all years
blkgrp_adjusted_data <- Map(
  adjust_blkgrp_counts,
  year            = names(blkgrp_prediction_files),
  prediction_file = blkgrp_prediction_files,
  housing_data    = blkgrp_housing_list,
  output_file     = blkgrp_output_files
)
```

# zip code level
```{r}

# Prediction files (2020 only shown here — expand for 2000 and 2010 if needed)
prediction_files <- list(
  "2000" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_zcta_with_county_2000.csv",
  "2010" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_zcta_with_county_2010.csv",
  "2015" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_zcta_with_county_2015.csv",
  "2020" = "./results/FINALdata/summary_zcta_with_county_2020.csv"
)

# ZCTA-level total housing units (CSV, last column = total units, NAME contains the 5-digit ZCTA)
housing_files <- list(
  "2000" = "./Totalhousing_2000_zcta.csv",
  "2010" = "./Totalhousing_2010_zcta.csv",
  "2015" = "./Totalhousing_2010_zcta.csv",
  "2020" = "./Totalhousing_2020_zcta.csv"
)

# Output locations
output_files <- list(
  "2000" = "./summary_zcta_adjusted_2000.csv",
  "2010" = "./summary_zcta_adjusted_2010.csv",
  "2015" = "./summary_zcta_adjusted_2015.csv",
  "2020" = "./summary_zcta_adjusted_2020.csv"
)

# Define the function to adjust AC counts by ZCTA

adjust_zcta_counts <- function(year, prediction_path, housing_path, output_path) {
  # Read prediction data
  prediction <- read_csv(prediction_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(ZCTA = sprintf("%05s", as.character(ZCTA)))

  # Read housing data and extract ZCTA
  housing_raw <- read_csv(housing_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Identify the last column (assumed to be total housing units)
  last_col_name <- colnames(housing_raw)[ncol(housing_raw)]

  # Rename last column to total_units and extract ZCTA from NAME
  housing <- housing_raw %>%
    rename(total_units = all_of(last_col_name)) %>%
    mutate(ZCTA = str_extract(NAME, "\\d{5}"),
           ZCTA = sprintf("%05s", ZCTA)) %>%
    distinct(ZCTA, total_units)

  # Join and adjust counts
  adjusted <- prediction %>%
    left_join(housing, by = "ZCTA") %>%
    group_by(ZCTA) %>%
    mutate(
      total_predicted = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
      scaling_factor = if_else(total_predicted > total_units, total_units / total_predicted, 1),
      Adjusted_Count = round(Count * scaling_factor),
      Adjusted_Percentage = round(100 * Adjusted_Count / sum(Adjusted_Count), 2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(GEOID, ZCTA, ACtype, Adjusted_Count, Adjusted_Percentage) %>%
    drop_na(ZCTA)

  # Save result
  write_csv(adjusted, output_path)
  return(adjusted)
}


# Apply across all years
adjusted_data <- mapply(
  adjust_zcta_counts,
  year = names(prediction_files),
  prediction_path = prediction_files,
  housing_path = housing_files,
  output_path = output_files,
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE
)



```








# calculating weighted count & percentage
```{r}

# Load your AC prediction data
df <- read_csv("./results/FINALdata/summary_tract_2010.csv",
               show_col_types = FALSE)
if ("GEOID10" %in% names(df)) df <- rename(df, GEOID = GEOID10)
df$GEOID <- as.character(df$GEOID)

# Use acs_2010_all to extract total housing units
# Keep only GEOID and estimate columns and rename estimate to total_units
acs_tract_units <- acs_2010_all %>%
  select(GEOID, total_units = estimate)

# Step 1: Join ACS total_units to the AC prediction data by GEOID
df <- df %>%
  left_join(acs_tract_units, by = "GEOID")

# Step 2: Calculate weighted predicted percentage using ACS housing totals
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    weighted_count = Count,  # the model's predicted count already
    weighted_percentage = Count / total_units * 100
  )

# Step 3: Round percentage for display
df <- df %>%
  mutate(weighted_percentage = round(weighted_percentage, 2))

# View result
head(df)

write.csv(df, "./results/summary_tract_2010_weights.csv")
```

```{r}
# Set your Census API key (you only need to do this once)

  geography = "state",
  variables = "B25136_001E", # !Total Housing Units:
  year = 2022,
  survey = "acs5",
  #geometry = TRUE,          # Set to FALSE if you don't need spatial data
  cache_table = TRUE
)

acs_2020_conus <- acs_2020 %>%
  filter(!NAME %in% non_conus)

sum(acs_2020_conus$estimate)
# Save to a file if needed
write.csv(acs_2020_conus , "./acs2020_house_county.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
